question: Is the rainfall-associated higher-order within-taxon spatial coherence dependent on any single state?
endpoint: Exactly the previously frozen higher_order_within_species_mass = sum choose(max(k-1,0),2) across route-new taxa.
model: higher_order_mass ~ rain_contrast + temperature_difference + day_of_year_difference + year_gap + State + RunNumber, route-clustered covariance.

leave_one_state_out.procedure: Refit the unchanged model once omitting each sampled state.
leave_one_state_out.rule_source: Exactly mirrors the frozen RC11 geographic-generality audit.

state_specific: Descriptive only; fit within states with enough route clusters for clustered covariance and report sign/CI distribution.
interpretation: Strong pass means no single sampled state is required for the pooled higher-order association.
It does not imply homogeneous effect strength across states or universality beyond NAAMP.
No endpoint or decision rule may change after readback.
